from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper parsed for citation relationships."""
    paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper being processed")
    cited_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers explicitly cited in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
